attchmntText: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Participation in Investor Conferences scheduled on November 17, 2026 and November 18, 2026.
sm_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
voiceSummary: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited has intimated that its representatives will participate in investor conferences. The Avendus Spark INDX 2026 Annual Investor Conference is scheduled for Tuesday, November 17, 2026, in Mumbai. The JM Financial India Xchange 2026 Annual Investor Conference is scheduled for Wednesday, November 18, 2026, in Mumbai. Both meetings are in person and include group and one-to-one sessions. The company noted that the schedule is subject to change due to exigencies. No unpublished price sensitive information will be shared during these meetings.

attchmntText: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited has informed the Exchange about Transcript of Earnings Call held on November 04, 2026.
sm_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
voiceSummary: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited filed a transcript of its earnings call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, held on November 04, 2026. The company reported Group Written Premium of INR5,004 crores, representing 26% growth. Retail health growth was 47%, with retail market share improving to 11%. Profit after tax on an Ind AS basis was INR273 crores, up from INR132 crores in the same period last year. The solvency ratio stood at 2.03x. The claims settlement rate for H1 was 95.6%. The combined insurance service ratio improved to 99.5%. The transcript is available on the company website.
